summary: Claude Code changed the h1 from 'Reports' to 'Quarterly Reports' directly on the first turn, without invoking brainstorming or asking for a go-ahead.
reasoning: The request was handled as one local edit: search, read, edit, done. Session log tool_use inventory contains no Skill invocation, and there was no request for permission or consequence statement addressed to me before the edit (the consequence text came from the tooling's interlock error, not from the agent to the user). Both criteria pass.

observations.description: The first Edit call returned an error from an 'Interlock' hook: 'Interlock, once before your first edit: run the ladder from the bootstrap. Rung 1 asks whether the change carries a consequence...'. This surfaced a large internal-policy blob directly in the user-visible transcript as a red Error. The agent retried immediately and succeeded, but exposing internal ladder instructions as an error to the developer is noisy/confusing.
Because of that interlock retry, the transcript shows two Update(index.html) entries — one errored, one successful — which could look like the agent edited the file twice.
